task: Write one sentence of your own using the word reconfigures. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know reconfigures should be able to work it out from your sentence.

Rearranges is the everyday word for moving the same pieces into a new order — furniture shoved around a living room until it feels right. Reconfigures suggests a system with planned layouts behind it: cabins, consoles, software, floor plans snapped from one designed arrangement into another.

The Verso Theater has no fixed seats.
Every riser, rail, and platform locks into a grid of floor sockets.
When a run ends, the crew reconfigures the entire hall overnight, working from one of nine layouts the architects drew before the building opened.
For an opera the platforms make a steep horseshoe; for a boxing drama they become a ring with seats on all four sides.
Visitors sometimes assume the crew improvises.
In fact nothing is moved without the layout sheet, and every socket is numbered.
By morning the same eight hundred pieces have become, on plan, a different theater.
